rules.title: Game Rules
rules.objective_content: Move all 4 of your pawns from your starting base, around the board, and into the center square to win.
rules.cowrie_content: Each turn you throw 4 cowrie shells. The score equals the number of shells that land face-up (mouth-up). If all 4 land face-down the score is 8.
rules.roll_0: 0 (all face-down = 8) — Grace! Move 8 squares and enter a pawn. Extra turn.
rules.roll_1: 1 — Grace! Move 1 square and enter a pawn. Extra turn.
rules.roll_4: 4 — Grace! Move 4 squares and enter a pawn. Extra turn.
rules.movement_content: Pawns enter the board from your base on a grace roll, travel clockwise around the outside path, then spiral inward to the center. Landing on an opponent's pawn on a non-safe square sends it back to base.
rules.safe_squares_content: Squares marked with ✦ are safe. Pawns resting on safe squares cannot be captured.
rules.rule1: Roll 4 cowrie shells to determine your move
rules.rule2: A roll of 1 or 8 allows entering a new pawn onto the board
rules.rule3: A roll of 1, 4, or 8 grants an extra turn
rules.rule4: Landing on an opponent's pawn on a non-safe square captures it
rules.rule5: Captured pawns return to their starting base
rules.rule6: Safe squares protect pawns from capture
rules.rule7: Guide all 4 of your pawns home to win
